scope.requested: Entire ROM2.4 C codebase and execution-affecting data
scope.inventory_limitations: Lexical scan, not preprocessed/compiler AST; disabled definitions retained; function pointers/macros and implicit branches require manual resolution.

snapshot.revision_evidence: Read .git/HEAD and refs/heads/master; git work-tree commands fail in this environment.
snapshot.dirty_status: Normal git status unavailable. HEAD content comparison is recorded separately; staging and mode status unknown. Per-file SHA-256 identifies actual bytes.

head_content_comparison.method: Compare raw and CRLF-to-LF normalized Git blob SHA-1 against HEAD tree. Does not inspect staging or file-mode status.

build_assumptions: No C build or gameplay probe performed.
Default Makefile: gcc -Wall -O -g, crypt linkage; Linux/normal/Solaris variants retained.
Preprocessor alternatives including macintosh, MSDOS, unix and NOCRYPT are not resolved by the lexical inventory.
Specified ASCII string cases assume valid NUL-terminated arrays, sufficient buffers, locale-independent ASCII LOWER.
C integer examples assume representable signed arithmetic with division truncating toward zero. Undefined inputs are not portable oracles.
